# EcclesiaOS v1.0.44

## Release summary

EcclesiaOS v1.0.44 is a focused stable update for member profiles and Leadership Report Settings. It removes the unused Volunteer Hours summary card and fixes the 403 response administrators encountered when changing Eligible Reviewer Roles.

## Fixes

- Removed Volunteer Hours from the Member Profile summary.
- Rebalanced the profile summary so Member details, Attendance Score, Giving Consistency, and Profile Completeness fit cleanly on one row at desktop sizes.
- Fixed Eligible Reviewer Roles updates when the new role policy excludes the previously selected Default Reviewer.
- Automatically clears an incompatible Default Reviewer while saving the administrator's new reviewer-role policy.
- Continues to block direct attempts to assign a reviewer who is not eligible under the saved role policy.

## Database and deployment

- No new database migration is required for this release.
- Existing Leadership Report settings remain compatible.

## Verification

- Full application suite passed: 278 tests and 3,145 assertions.
- Leadership Report settings, reviewer-role authorization, member profile rendering, and operational module regressions passed.
- Composer validation and security audit passed.
- npm audit completed with zero vulnerabilities.
- Laravel Pint and Blade template compilation passed.
- Production Vite assets built successfully.
